meta.name: k8s-operator
meta.description: Query and diagnose the home Kubernetes cluster. Use when checking cluster health, troubleshooting pods/services/routes, inspecting storage, or understanding what's deployed. Covers Talos node management, Ceph storage, Cilium networking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 随时检查集群健康,快速定位异常来源
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果自己维护K8s集群,经常需要检查和诊断状态
copy.tagline_en: Check cluster health and troubleshoot issues in pods, services, and storage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a Kubernetes cluster and need to quickly inspect and diagnose it.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 先用只读命令查询集群状态再定位问题;可检查节点、Pod、存储(Ceph)、网络(Cilium),不直接改集群,改动走 GitOps。
howto.when: 当你要求检查集群健康、排查 Pod/服务/路由问题,或了解已部署内容时触发。

say.text: 检查一下集群当前的健康状态。
say.note: Claude 会查询节点和最近事件。

say.text: 有哪些 Pod 没在运行?
say.note: 会列出所有非 Running 状态的 Pod。
会执行 ceph status 查看存储健康。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude first queries the cluster with read-only commands, then pinpoints issues. It can inspect nodes, pods, Ceph storage, and Cilium networking, and avoids direct cluster changes—changes go through GitOps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to check cluster health, troubleshoot pod/service/route issues, inspect storage, or see what's deployed.

say_en.text: Check the current health of the cluster.
say_en.note: Claude queries nodes and recent events.
Lists all pods not in Running state.

say_en.text: How is the Ceph storage doing?
say_en.note: Runs ceph status to check storage health.
